patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Hive only if your buying job matches “Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — ” rather than Motion's shape. Choose Motion only if your buying job matches “AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo an” rather than Hive's shape. Workflow advantage: Hive leans team-collaboration-work; Motion leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Hive is Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — strong monday.com peer.; Motion is AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo annual..
- Workflow coverage skew: Hive-leaning team-collaboration-work vs Motion-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Hive — Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Motion — Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors.

Limitations — Hive: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Free storage (200MB) and AI credits (1k) are tight for active teams; Motion: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors; AI credit caps and top-ups affect TCO.

Poor-fit cases: Hive is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams · Motion is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors · Avoid Hive if you actually need Motion's motion (AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
